description: This Java class defines a model for writing 'Thing' objects into a MongoDB database, encapsulating the document to be stored and providing methods for creating instances and converting to MongoDB write operations.

classes.name: ThingWriteModel
classes.description: A thread-unsafe model representing a MongoDB write operation for a complete 'Thing', including document data and behavior to generate MongoDB replace operations.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of ThingWriteModel with given metadata and document to write.

methods.name: toMongo
methods.description: Converts this model into a MongoDB ReplaceOneModel for database write operations.

methods.name: getThingDocument
methods.description: Returns the Document representing the 'Thing' to be persisted.
